why: expectNoOverflowAcrossDevices accepts a locale override but none of this file's 4 cases pass one, so every case renders English-only in an RTL/bilingual app where Hebrew strings routinely run a different length than English (and, per the wizard finding above, several of these exact widgets currently render un-translated English anyway). The OnboardingProfileCreationStep case exists specifically to guard a tablet/keyboard-compressed-height regression (768x640) — exactly the tight corner where longer Hebrew text (interpolated names, the un-localized 'A profile with this name already exists' error) is most likely to newly overflow — yet it is never checked there.
recommendation: Duplicate each case (or parametrize with a locale list) to also run at locale: const Locale('he'), at minimum for the OnboardingProfileCreationStep keyboard-compressed corner.
acceptance_criteria: each of the 4 expectNoOverflowAcrossDevices calls in this file also runs at Locale('he') and passes
